proof_boundary: This gate proves the parity-correct Xi Fourier/score-moment representation of the regular field and exact positive-kernel and strongly-log-concave families realizing every real field. It proves no bound for the actual Xi moment ratio, no simultaneous theta-contact theorem, no degree-uniform Jensen remainder, no Xi collision exclusion, Lambda<=0, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.certificate: Regular-field, score, strong-shape, theta-tail, and modular guards are audited.
rows.claim: Five parent contracts are current and hash-pinned.
rows.proof_boundary: No parent result is strengthened.

rows.certificate: M_k(c,t)=integral_0^infinity u^k f_t(u)exp(icu)du and H_t^(k)(c)=Re[i^k M_k(c,t)].
rows.claim: Every spatial derivative is one real projection of an adjacent Fourier moment.
rows.proof_boundary: Differentiation is justified by the Xi super-exponential tail.

rows.certificate: At a multiplicity-m zero c, Re[i^jM_j]=0 for 0<=j<m, Re[i^mM_m]!=0, and B_c=Re[i^(m+1)M_(m+1)]/((m+1)Re[i^mM_m]).
rows.claim: Multiplicity and the regular field are exact adjacent-moment conditions.
rows.proof_boundary: The denominator is nonzero by exact multiplicity.

rows.certificate: For even m, B_c=-S_(m+1)/[(m+1)C_m]; for odd m, B_c=C_(m+1)/[(m+1)S_m], where C_k=int u^k f cos(cu) and S_k=int u^k f sin(cu).
rows.claim: The cosine/sine ratio and its sign depend on the parity of m.
rows.proof_boundary: No absolute-value replacement is allowed.

rows.certificate: ell=(2cB_c-m)/4.
rows.claim: The Jensen field is recovered exactly from the signed-variable moment ratio.
rows.proof_boundary: Uses rho=-c^2 and the established field conversion.

rows.certificate: dnu_t(u)=-f_t'(u)du/f_t(0), S_t(x)=E_nu[sin(xU)], and H_t(x)=f_t(0)S_t(x)/x for x>0.
rows.claim: The same contact is encoded by the positive Xi score law.
rows.proof_boundary: This imports the proved monotone-kernel integration by parts.

rows.certificate: A multiplicity-m zero of H_t at c>0 is exactly a multiplicity-m zero of S_t; B_c=S_t^(m+1)(c)/[(m+1)S_t^(m)(c)]-1/c.
rows.claim: The full multiplicity transfers through the nonzero factor 1/x.
rows.proof_boundary: Only c>0 is used.

rows.certificate: ell=c*S_t^(m+1)(c)/[2(m+1)S_t^(m)(c)]-(m+2)/4. For even m, B_c=Cnu_(m+1)/[(m+1)Snu_m]-1/c; for odd m, B_c=-Snu_(m+1)/[(m+1)Cnu_m]-1/c.
rows.claim: The exact Xi-field target is one adjacent score-moment ratio.
rows.proof_boundary: The ratio remains signed and oscillatory.

rows.certificate: H_(m,y,c)(x)=sinc(pi*x/c)^m*sinc(y*x/c), pi<y<2pi. It is the characteristic function of the convolution of m Uniform[-pi/c,pi/c] laws and one Uniform[-y/c,y/c] law.
rows.claim: A sinc product supplies a positive compact frequency kernel with an m-fold contact.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a countermodel family, not Xi.

rows.certificate: The frequency density is even, compactly supported, and log-concave because it is a convolution of interval indicators.
rows.claim: The compact kernel is even and log-concave.
rows.proof_boundary: It is not smooth at every spline knot.

rows.certificate: At x=c, B_c=(y*cot(y)-m-1)/c and ell=(2y*cot(y)-3m-2)/4. y*cot(y) decreases continuously from +infinity to -infinity on (pi,2pi), so the compact positive-kernel model realizes every real ell.
rows.claim: The positive-kernel family realizes every real ell.
rows.proof_boundary: The tuning phase is uniquely selected in (pi,2pi).

rows.certificate: For every tau, H_tau(x)=int p(u)exp(tau*u^2)exp(ixu)du. For tau>=0, exp(-tau D_x^2) preserves the Laguerre-Polya class; for tau<0 the multiplicity-m local limit exp(D_z^2)z^m has a nonreal pair. Thus the compact model has exact threshold zero.
rows.claim: The compact model has a full all-time heat flow and threshold zero.
rows.proof_boundary: This uses Laguerre-Polya preservation and local Hermite splitting.

rows.certificate: Multiplying H_(m,y,c) by exp(-q*x^2/2) convolves its compact kernel with N(0,q) and changes B_c by -q*c. The smoothed model has ell=[2y*cot(y)-3m-2-2q*c^2]/4; the same phase bijection realizes every real ell and gives a continuous positive score law.
rows.claim: Gaussian smoothing keeps the contact and leaves the field freely tunable.
rows.proof_boundary: Its positive-time heat interval ends at the Gaussian integrability threshold.

rows.certificate: If the compact summand Y lies in [-R,R], then (log p_q)''=Var(Y|X=u)/q^2-1/q<=-(q-R^2)/q^2. Choosing q=((m+2)^2*pi^2+1)/c^2>R^2 makes the kernel smooth, positive, even, strictly decreasing, and uniformly strongly log-concave.
rows.claim: The smoothed frequency kernel has an explicit negative curvature ceiling.
rows.proof_boundary: The tail is Gaussian, not theta-type.

rows.certificate: Positive Fourier representation, compact log-concavity, or smooth positive uniform strong log-concavity plus local first-loss dynamics do not bound ell.
rows.claim: A continuous positive score probability and strong kernel curvature do not bound ell.
rows.proof_boundary: This does not combine the exact contact with the Xi theta tail.

rows.certificate: The strong model has Gaussian rather than Xi double-exponential tails. The existing theta-tail weighted countermodel separately forbids shape-and-tail promotion, but does not by itself realize this exact contact.
rows.claim: Generic Xi-like shape and tail information is separately insufficient for correlation positivity.
rows.proof_boundary: The two countermodels are not silently merged into one model.

rows.certificate: sinc(pi*x/c) vanishes at x=c because sin(pi)=0; the Xi Fourier convention itself adds no hidden pi here.
rows.claim: Pi enters only as the first nonzero zero of the uniform characteristic sine.
rows.proof_boundary: This pi is from the explicit uniform model, not inserted into the Xi moment identity.

rows.certificate: A surviving field theorem must use the simultaneous Xi theta/modular source and multiple-contact moment equations, or bypass ell through global first-jet winding.
rows.claim: Any closing field restriction must use simultaneous Xi modular arithmetic and contact.
rows.proof_boundary: No actual Xi field bound is proved.

rows.certificate: The cofinal Jensen route still independently requires a remainder uniform in degree.
rows.claim: The local moment formula does not control the cofinal Jensen error.
rows.proof_boundary: No degree-uniform remainder is proved.

rows.certificate: It proves the exact moment coordinates and generic positive-kernel/score nonclosure.
rows.claim: This gate is not a proof of RH.
rows.proof_boundary: No Xi field bound, collision exclusion, Lambda<=0, RH, or prize-level conclusion is proved.
